values.note: Forest Service-run, first come first serve; no host on site. Camping limited to 16 consecutive days.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/crazy-creek-campground (Reservations: 'Sites are available on a first come first serve basis. Camping limited to 16 consecutive days.'; 'No host on site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Campground can accommodate trailers under 26 feet.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/crazy-creek-campground ('a small campground with 7 sites', 'Campground can accommodate trailers under 26 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hand pump for potable water, seasonal (May to September). Picnic tables, fire rings. No garbage service (pack it in, pack it out). Horses/pack animals not allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/crazy-creek-campground ('picnic tables, fire rings, vault toilet and a hand pump for potable water. values.note: 'Peak season is Memorial Day through Labor Day. Open yearlong until closed by snow.'

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/crazy-creek-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'Single Site: $12 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night'), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot NF (Sula RD) beside Warm Springs Creek, a tributary of the East Fork Bitterroot River: 2.9 mi northwest of Sula on US 93, then 4 mi west on Medicine Springs Rd #370. Distinct from the nearby Crazy Creek Horse Camp. --Claude
